protocol.target: mean hourly load per reporting stable apartment (Wh)
protocol.forecast: 24 hourly values for every test day
protocol.information_set: target observations strictly before the origin; lag baselines use >=24 h lags
protocol.folds: expanding window with train_start fixed at 2017-05-01; one fold tests Sep-Dec 2017 and one tests May-Jun 2018
protocol.mase_scale: mean absolute 24-h seasonal difference over valid training pairs
protocol.best_baseline_selection: lowest MASE on the all-four-baseline mask when it covers >=50% of evaluation hours (and >=24 h); otherwise on the evaluation mask
protocol.significance: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired absolute errors vs the best baseline; p-values unadjusted; small_sample flags fewer than 10 pairs
protocol.learned_models: xgboost is fit on the fold's training window labels only; its features at target hour t use observations at t-lag with lag >= 24 h, so all features predate the day's 00:00 IST origin; reporting counts and weather are lagged >=24 h; calendar/holiday/semester flags are known in advance; labels clipped at a train-only Q3+3*IQR cap. sarima is refit weekly on the trailing 60 days before each Monday origin and advanced daily only with actuals before the day's origin
protocol.sarima: order (1,0,1)(0,1,1,24); weekly refit on the trailing 60 days of gap-handled target; daily state updates with actuals up to each origin; recovery refit after coverage gaps
protocol.quantiles: xgboost_quantile fits one model per quantile (0.1, 0.5, 0.9) with objective reg:quantileerror on the same features, labels, and cap as xgboost; P10-P90 coverage and pinball loss are reported per fold, and P50 is also scored as a point forecast

baseline_descriptions.persistence: last observed value before the forecast day, held flat for 24 h
baseline_descriptions.seasonal_naive_24: value at the same hour on the previous day
baseline_descriptions.same_hour_last_week: value at the same hour one week earlier
baseline_descriptions.mean_last_4_same_weekdays: mean of the same hour on the previous four same weekdays

learned_model_descriptions.xgboost: pooled direct day-ahead gradient-boosted trees on lags of 24-47, 168 and 336 h, calendar/holiday/semester flags, hour of day, lagged reporting counts, and lagged Mumbai weather; trained only on the fold's training labels, clipped at the train-only outlier cap
learned_model_descriptions.sarima: SARIMA(1,0,1)(0,1,1,24) on the gap-handled target, refit weekly on the trailing 60 days before each Monday origin and advanced daily with actuals up to each day's origin
learned_model_descriptions.xgboost_quantile: three XGBoost quantile models (P10/P50/P90) on the same features, training window, and train-only cap as the point XGBoost; fixed untuned hyperparameters; predictions clipped at zero and rearranged so quantiles do not cross

weather.information_set: weather lags >= 24 h only; no target-hour weather

tuning.selection: median best_iteration across the CV validation slices

sarima.refit_policy: Mondays and first test day; recovery refit after coverage gaps
